releaseNotes:
Fixed: a Product or New Connection payment printed LOAN wording on the customer's receipt.

Products and connection fees share the same internal machinery as a loan, and the receipt was keyed on that rather than on the payment type. So recording a Rs. 15,000 new connection printed "Loan Amount 15,000 / Loan Balance 0 / Loan Status Cleared" on a receipt handed to a customer who had never been lent anything. Loan wording now appears only on an actual loan; an item names itself and shows what is still owed on it.

Fixed: the payment type buttons were clipped to "Installmen" and "New" because six categories no longer fit one row. They wrap now.

Receipts print for every payment type - that was never gated on the category, only on a printer being available, and it says so plainly when there is not one.
